items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Segmented YoRHa gauge bar on Base UI Progress (or variant="dots": three rows of 2 px dots in whole columns). Determinate shows the value in aria-valuenow and aria-valuetext (formatValue to customise) and advances by a 180 ms stepped clip; indeterminate omits aria-valuenow and hops a block across the track in --yorha-step-loop steps while mounted (reduced: opacity pulse; off: stripes).
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. The gauge seams are a CSS gradient; no original assets are used. v4: indeterminate easing is --yorha-step-loop (was --yorha-ease-emphasized; reduced keeps the eased pulse); new props variant and formatValue. Increases animate with clip-path only (never width).
